hooks.command: echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"PR screenshot rule: before finalizing this PR, use Playwright to capture screenshots of the feature(s) built on this branch (browser_navigate + browser_take_screenshot), then add the relevant screenshot to the PR description or a PR comment using GitHub's attachment flow. If upload is blocked, replace the single fixed file docs/screenshots/pr-screenshot.png, commit only that file, and link the GitHub blob page for that file from the PR description or a PR comment; do not use raw.githubusercontent.com URLs for private repos. If you have not captured and attached or linked screenshots yet, cancel this command, do that first, then re-run gh pr create.\"}}"
